about.title: Profile
about.description: Operational manager with 8+ years of experience in project management and team support.
about.texte:
Operational manager with over 8 years of experience in client relations, strategic support, and digital transformation. Founder of a digital marketing agency (500+ clients, 34M views). Startup co-founder with a Ledger co-creator. Expertise in digital tools deployment, workflow automation, and artificial intelligence.

Self-taught and driven by continuous improvement: independently trained in web development (React, Node.js), automation (n8n, Make, APIs), and artificial intelligence (prompt engineering, Claude Code, AI agents). Proven ability to rapidly upskill on new tools and deploy them in real-world conditions.

Key skills: digital project management, cross-functional team coordination, change management, user support and training, digital tools deployment and team upskilling.

Accredited photographer for Rolling Stone France and Forbes. Contributor at Rolling Stone France on SEO and automation process implementation with AI tools. International Photography Awards 2023 Winner. A cultural and artistic sensitivity that enriches my project vision.
about.highlight: Ready to bring my project management experience and support skills to your organization.

tachfin.name: Tachfin Khelil
tachfin.title: General Manager - John Paul
tachfin.text: As site director at John Paul Lisbon, I had the pleasure of working with Denis ADAM, whose dedication, rigor, and versatility greatly contributed to the quality of our premium service. He structured and strengthened our night concierge team, while showing strong crisis management and customer experience skills. Proactive, resilient, and always solution-oriented, Denis earned the trust of clients and colleagues alike. I highly recommend him for any position requiring leadership, adaptability, and excellence in relationships.
